scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled inventory-products report source through the real worker

criteria.description: The existing inventory-products catalog contract is preserved with exactly eight fields, literal search, inclusive UTC createdAt filters, deterministic ordering, a 10,000-row bound and explicit exclusions.
criteria.limitations: The existing catalog is a current persisted inventory_items snapshot and does not establish complete Vetus inventory parity, historical/as-of stock or valuation semantics.

criteria.description: The shared source reads only inventory_items with explicit tenant context and account predicate, explicit projection, parameterized escaped literal ILIKE, inclusive UTC date boundaries, deterministic ordering and a 10,001-row query limit.
criteria.limitations: The source proof is local/disposable; target grants, target RLS/runtime roles, production scale and operational database acceptance remain outside this bounded gate.

criteria.description: The worker composes the asynchronous inventory-products source, validates filters and source responses, maps exactly eight fields and retains existing scheduled job, audit, recipient and one-shot semantics.
criteria.limitations: Continuous/distributed worker operations and delivery providers are not certified by this bounded gate.

criteria.description: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL process evidence proves concurrent two-account run-once isolation, literal wildcard escaping, inclusive UTC date boundaries, exact rows, durable execution and non-PII audit.
criteria.limitations: The process uses disposable local PostgreSQL and mock delivery; it does not certify target roles, provider delivery, distributed execution, external systems or production behavior.

criteria.description: Intentional RED/GREEN, focused coverage, full module and worker regressions, typecheck/build, secrets, formatting and diff hygiene satisfy the bounded repository quality bar.
criteria.limitations: The validators are local; remote CI, target operations, external homologation and release acceptance remain open.

criteria.description: A fresh read-only independent review returned bounded approval without a CRITICAL, HIGH or MEDIUM finding; its LOW test-coverage observation was addressed by a real PostgreSQL process assertion and rerun.
criteria.limitations: Approval is limited to this bounded local slice and is not a global ERP, target or production approval.

criteria.description: The bounded result is reconciled without promoting CVG-004, general Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness, target operations or release acceptance.
criteria.limitations: General Vetus parity remains 4/11 verified, clinical parity 2/3 verified and enterprise readiness 95/100 with 42 PASS, 3 WARN and 1 FAIL.

gaps: The report is a current persisted inventory_items snapshot only; historical/as-of stock, lots, movements, invoices and valuation remain outside scope.

Disposable local services do not certify target RLS/roles, backup/restore, RTO/RPO, distributed worker operations, remote CI, accessibility, operational LGPD, providers, production or release acceptance.
Complete Vetus inventory and scheduled-report parity remains unverified even though this exact worker slice is bounded and reviewed.
conditions: Keep the result limited to the authenticated tenant-scoped scheduled read path over persisted inventory_items with the exact eight-field contract.
Keep CVG-004/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.

Revalidate before changing inventory schema/RLS, adding joins/fields/filters, changing schedule/audit behavior, adding stock/movement/invoice/valuation behavior, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill or release action.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation request and original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled inventory-products report source through the real worker
authority.decision: Authorize only the repository-local read-only inventory-products source, worker resolver/bootstrap wiring and disposable two-account verification under the existing schedule/audit semantics. The source may expose only sku, name, unit, onHandQuantity, reorderLevel, unitCostAmount, createdAt and updatedAt from persisted inventory_items, derive tenant scope from the claimed schedule, apply case-insensitive literal SKU/name search and strict inclusive UTC createdAt date filters, deterministic name/id order and a 10,000-row bound, and fail closed on missing/foreign/malformed source output. Exclude lots, movements, invoices, current-stock derivation, historical/as-of valuation, migrations, CRUD, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing inventory_items schema/RLS or numeric/timestamp semantics, adding joins/fields/filters, changing worker schedule/audit behavior, adding stock/movement/invoice/valuation behavior, provider delivery, target operations or production behavior.

next_action: Keep CVG-004/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL with promotion BLOCKED; choose any next gap only through fresh scouting and a new implementation-ready authority.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to inventory_items schema, account RLS/FORCE-RLS or persisted quantity/cost/timestamp semantics
Changes to worker bootstrap, schedule claiming, report execution/export/audit or one-shot failure behavior
Expansion beyond the scheduled inventory-products read path
